get.description:
Retrieves a list of account permissions associated with accounts in the system. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination to narrow down results by permission name, type, account, or access group.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AccessPermissionId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountPermissionAccessId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountPermissionId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountPermissionName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| PermissionCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| PermissionsName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| TypeOfPermission | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| UserId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=AccessPermissionId~cn~100`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| AccessPermissionId | Sort by the access permission id. |
| AccountId | Sort by the account id. |
| AccountPermissionAccessId | Sort by the account permission access id. |
| AccountPermissionId | Sort by the account permission id. |
| AccountPermissionName | Sort by the account permission name. |
| IsActive | Sort by the is active. |
| PermissionCode | Sort by the permission code. |
| PermissionsName | Sort by the permissions name. |
| TypeOfPermission | Sort by the type of permission. |
| UserId | Sort by the user id. |
| PortalId | Sort by the portal id. |

**Example:**
- `sort=AccessPermissionId~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| znodeaccountpermissionaccesses | Includes related znodeaccountpermissionaccesses details in the response. |

**Example:**
- `["znodeaccountpermissionaccesses"]`

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of all accounts in the system. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

Each account record includes details such as account name, code, portal association, catalog assignment, and address information.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AccountAddressId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AccountProfileId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AddressId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| DepartmentId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| IsDefault | is (Is) |
| NoteId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PriceListId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| UserApproverId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| UserId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodeAddress | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| classnumber | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ew (EndsWith), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), or (OR), not in (NotIn), ncn (NotContains), bw (Between), nlk (NotLike) |
| AccountCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| AccountName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ParentAccountId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |

**Example:**
- `filter=AccountName~cn~Acme`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| AccountAddressId | Sort by the account address identifier. |
| AccountId | Sort by the account identifier. |
| AccountProfileId | Sort by the account profile identifier. |
| AddressId | Sort by the address identifier. |
| DepartmentId | Sort by the department identifier. |
| IsDefault | Sort by the default status. |
| NoteId | Sort by the note identifier. |
| PortalId | Sort by the portal (store) identifier. |
| PriceListId | Sort by the price list identifier. |
| UserApproverId | Sort by the user approver identifier. |
| UserId | Sort by the user identifier. |
| ZnodeAddress | Sort by the address. |
| classnumber | Sort by the class number. |
| AccountCode | Sort by the account code. |
| AccountName | Sort by the account name. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |

**Example:**
- `sort=AccountName~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| additional-attributes | Includes additional custom attributes defined for accounts in the response. |
| selected-additional-attributes | Includes only the selected subset of additional attributes in the response. |
| znodeuser | Includes the user details associated with the account in the response. |
| znodeaccountpermissionaccesses | Includes the account permission access settings in the response. |
| ZnodeAddress | Includes the account address details in the response. |
| catalog | Includes the catalog associated with the account in the response. |
| portal | Includes the portal (store) associated with the account in the response. |

**Example:**
- `["additional-attributes"]`

---

put.description:
Moves a category to a different position within the catalog hierarchy. The request body specifies the target position using the parent category hierarchy identifiers.

## API Behavior

### ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId

ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId represents the hierarchy ID of the parent category under which the category needs to be added or moved.
- If ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId is 0, the category specified by PimCategoryHierarchyId will be added/moved as a parent category.
- If a valid ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId is provided, the category will be moved under the specified parent category.
- An incorrect or invalid ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId can result in a 500 Internal Server Error.

### PimCategoryHierarchyId

PimCategoryHierarchyId represents the hierarchy ID of the category that needs to be moved.
- This property must contain a valid hierarchy ID.
- If PimCategoryHierarchyId is 0, the API will return a 500 Internal Server Error.

### PimCatalogId

A valid and correct PimCatalogId must be provided in the request.
- If an incorrect or invalid catalog ID is provided, the API can return a 500 Internal Server Error.

### Same Parent and Category Hierarchy IDs

PimCategoryHierarchyId and ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId must not contain the same value.
- If both properties contain the same hierarchy ID, the API will return a 500 Internal Server Error, as a category cannot be moved under itself.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| StoreName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ItemId | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ItemName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=PortalId~eq~1`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

Use the expand parameter to include additional related data such as SEO URLs, catalog details, category attributes, or product information.

---

### Expand Support

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `SEOUrl` | Includes the SEO-friendly URL for each category node in the tree. |
| `additional-attributes` | Includes additional custom attributes associated with each category node. |
| `catalog` | Includes the catalog details associated with the tree structure. |
| `category` | Includes full category details for each node in the tree. |
| `product` | Includes product information associated with the categories in the tree. |

**Example:**
- `["SEOUrl", "catalog"]`

get.summary: Retrieve an email template by code
get.description:
Retrieves a single email template by template code, scoped to a specific portal and locale.
Use this endpoint when you need the exact template content that is configured for a given store/portal and locale.

The API first attempts to return the template that matches the provided EmailTemplateCode, PortalId, and LocaleId. If no template is found for the requested locale, it automatically falls back to the system default locale for that same template code/portal context.
The response returns the resolved template payload when available (200 OK), or no content when no matching template exists (204 No Content). This endpoint is useful for rendering the correct localized transactional email template at runtime.

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of form builder configurations. Supports filtering by attribute type, group, attribute, entity, locale, and active status, with sorting and pagination.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AttributeTypeId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| GlobalAttributeGroupId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| GlobalAttributeId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| GlobalEntityId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=AttributeTypeId~cn~1`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| AttributeTypeId | Sort by the attribute type identifier. |
| GlobalAttributeGroupId | Sort by the attribute group identifier. |
| GlobalAttributeId | Sort by the attribute identifier. |
| GlobalEntityId | Sort by the entity identifier. |
| LocaleId | Sort by the locale identifier. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |

**Example:**
- `sort=AttributeTypeId~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| attributes | Includes the list of form attributes and their configuration details in the response. |
| globalattributegrouplocale | Includes localized display names and descriptions for attribute groups in the response. |
| groupmappers | Includes the group-to-entity mapping details in the response. |
| mediagrouplocale | Includes localized media group information associated with the form in the response. |
| portal | Includes the portal (store) configuration details associated with the form in the response. |

**Example:**
- `["attributes"]`

---

Creates a new global attribute with the specified attribute model and validation rules. Provide all required attribute details including the attribute code, type, and locale information.

**Key field validations:**
- `AttributeModel.AttributeCode`: Required, alphanumeric only (`^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$`), max 100 characters, must be unique.
- `AttributeModel.AttributeTypeId`: Must reference a valid attribute type identifier.
- `AttributeModel.AttributeDisplayOrder`: Integer between 1 and 999.
- `AttributeModel.IsRequired`: Boolean - set to `true` to make the attribute mandatory on input forms.
- `AttributeModel.IsLocalizable`: Boolean - set to `true` to enable locale-specific translations for this attribute.
- `AttributeModel.IsActive`: Boolean - set to `true` to activate the attribute.

**Use Cases:**
- Create a text attribute to capture additional product, account, or order-level data.
- Create a required attribute to enforce data entry when the attribute is assigned to an entity.
- Create a localizable attribute to support multi-language storefronts.
- Create an active or inactive attribute by toggling `AttributeModel.IsActive`.

post.description:
Checks whether the specified attribute values are unique for the given entity within the portal. Returns a response indicating whether the attribute value combination is valid and unique. Use this validation before saving attribute data to prevent duplicate values.

**Key field validations:**
- `PortalId`: Required - must reference a valid store portal identifier.
- `EntityType`: Required - specifies the type of entity being checked (e.g., `Product`, `Account`, `Order`).
- `GlobalAttributeCodeValueList`: Required - must contain at least one attribute code-value pair to validate.
- `Id`: The unique entity identifier scoped to the uniqueness check (e.g., the `FormBuilderId` when checking form attributes).
- `AttributeCodeValues`: A comma-separated list of `AttributeCode:Value` pairs (e.g., `COLOR:RED,SIZE:LARGE`) as an alternative to `GlobalAttributeCodeValueList`.

**Use Cases:**
- Validate that attribute values are unique before saving a new entity record.
- Check if a specific attribute code-value combination already exists for the given entity type within the portal.
- Use in form submission flows to provide real-time uniqueness feedback before persisting data.

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| attributes | Includes the list of attribute details for the global attribute. |
| groupmappers | Includes the group mapper assignments for the global attribute. |
| globalattributegroup | Includes the attribute group that the global attribute belongs to. |
| globalattributegrouplocale | Includes locale-specific details for the global attribute group. |
| globalattributefamily | Includes the attribute family associations for the global attribute. |
| globalattributefamilylocale | Includes locale-specific details for the global attribute family. |

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all available import types configured in the system. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~eq~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |

**Example:**
- `sort=CreatedDate~asc`


---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

The request body must include the file content encoded as Base64 in the ImportData field, along with the template settings, import type, portal, and any locale or catalog configuration required for the import.

To verify the actual import status and identify any errors, use the (Get Import Log Details)[https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/operations/getImportGetimportlogdetails] API. get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of all SKU inventory records across stores and warehouses. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| InventoryId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| WarehouseId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| SKU | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| Quantity | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ReOrderLevel | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ExternalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| CreatedBy | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ModifiedBy | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| BackOrderQuantity | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| BackOrderExpectedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=SKU~eq~PROD-001`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| InventoryId | Sort by the inventory identifier. |
| WarehouseId | Sort by the warehouse identifier. |
| SKU | Sort by the product SKU. |
| Quantity | Sort by the quantity. |
| ReOrderLevel | Sort by the reorder level. |
| ExternalId | Sort by the external identifier. |
| CreatedBy | Sort by the user who created the record. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedBy | Sort by the user who last modified the record. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| BackOrderQuantity | Sort by the back-order quantity. |
| BackOrderExpectedDate | Sort by the back-order expected date. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| PortalId | Sort by the store portal. |

**Example:**
- `sort=InventoryId~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=warehouses&expand=inventory`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| warehouses | Includes warehouse details (name, location, and address) for each SKU inventory record in the response. |
| inventory | Includes additional inventory data for each SKU inventory record in the response. |

**Example:**
- `["warehouses", "inventory"]`

---

Retrieves a paginated list of PIM attributes configured in the catalog. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

**Workflow:**

1. Use the **[CreatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Create/post)** API to create a new PIM attribute.
2. After successfully creating the attribute, use the **[SaveLocale](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-SaveLocales/post)** API to add or update the localized attribute name and description.
3. To update the core configuration of an existing PIM attribute, use the **[UpdatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Update/put)** API.
4. To retrieve a list of PIM attributes, use the **[PimAttributeList](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-List/get)** API.
5. To retrieve the details of a specific PIM attribute, use the **[GetPimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Get-id/get)** API.
6. To delete a PIM attribute, use the **[DeletePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Delete/post)** API.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AttributeTypeId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| InputValidationId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| IsPimAttributeType | is (Is) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PimAttributeDefaultValueId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PimAttributeId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PIMAttributeFamilyId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PIMAttributeGroupId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=PimAttributeId~eq~142`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| AttributeTypeId | Sort by the attribute type identifier. |
| InputValidationId | Sort by the input validation identifier. |
| IsPimAttributeType | Sort by whether the attribute is a PIM attribute type. |
| LocaleId | Sort by the locale identifier. |
| PimAttributeDefaultValueId | Sort by the attribute default value identifier. |
| PimAttributeId | Sort by the attribute identifier. |
| PIMAttributeFamilyId | Sort by the attribute family identifier. |
| PIMAttributeGroupId | Sort by the attribute group identifier. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status of the attribute. |

**Example:**

Retrieves the full configuration details for a single PIM attribute identified by its unique attribute ID. The response includes the attribute name, type, code, validation rules, display settings, and locale translations. Use the expand parameter to include additional related data such as attribute locales, group assignments, default values, and attribute families.

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ZnodePimAttributeGroupMappers | Includes the full list of attribute group mapper objects associated with this attribute. |
| ZnodePimDefaultAttributeValues | Includes the default selectable values for Select, Multi-Select, and Swatch type attributes. |
| attributelocale | Includes the locale-specific name and description translations for this attribute. |
| attributetype | Includes the attribute type details such as the type name and configuration options. |
| pimattributegroup | Includes information about the attribute group this attribute is assigned to. |
| attributes | Includes the full attribute configuration details in the response. |
| groupmappers | Includes the attribute-to-group mapping data showing which groups this attribute belongs to. |
| pimgrouplocale | Includes locale translations for the parent attribute group. |
| attributefamily | Includes the attribute family associations for this attribute. |

post.description:
Creates a new Product Information Management (PIM) attribute in the Znode catalog. A PIM attribute defines a custom or system property (e.g., Color, Size, Material) that can be associated with products or categories. The request must include an AttributeModel with a unique AttributeCode (alphanumeric, max 100 characters). Optional components include FrontProperties (display and search behavior) and ValidationRule (input constraints). On success, the newly created attribute data is returned along with its assigned PimAttributeId and locale information. **Note:** Creating a PIM attribute is only the first step of the implementation workflow. After successfully creating the attribute, you must call the [SaveLocales](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-SaveLocales/post) API to persist the localized attribute information. If the SaveLocales API is not executed, the attribute may not appear correctly in the Admin panel. **Workflow:** 1. Use the **[CreatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Create/post)** API to create a new PIM attribute. 2. After successfully creating the attribute, use the **[SaveLocale](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-SaveLocales/post)** API to add or update the localized attribute name and description. 3. To update the core configuration of an existing PIM attribute, use the **[UpdatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Update/put)** API. 4. To retrieve a list of PIM attributes, use the **[PimAttributeList](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-List/get)** API. 5. To retrieve the details of a specific PIM attribute, use the **[GetPimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Get-id/get)** API. 6. To delete a PIM attribute, use the **[DeletePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Delete/post)** API. **Key field validations:** - `AttributeCode`: Required, alphanumeric only (`^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$`), max 100 characters, must be unique - `DisplayOrder`: Integer between 1 and 999 - `AttributeTypeId`: Required; must reference a valid attribute type - `FrontProperties`: Required for create **Minimal request body:** 
{
  "AttributeModel": {
    "AttributeCode": "Color123",
    "AttributeTypeId": 1,
    "IsCategory": false
  },
  "FrontProperties": {
    "IsComparable": true,
    "IsUseInSearch": false,
    "IsAllowHtmlTag": true,
    "IsFacets": false
  }
}
**Use Cases:** - Create a product-level attribute (set `IsCategory: false`) - Create a category-level attribute (set `IsCategory: true`) - Create a localizable attribute for multi-language storefronts (set `IsLocalizable: true`) - Create a filterable/faceted attribute for search and navigation (set `IsFilterable: true`, `IsFacets: true`) --- ### Related APIs - **`GET`** [Get attribute List](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-List/get) - **`POST`** [Create Attribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Create/post) - **`DELETE`** [Delete Default Attribute Id](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-DeleteDefaultValues-defaultvalueId/delete) - **`PUT`** [Update attribute data](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Update/put) - **`POST`** [Save Locales](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-SaveLocales/post)

- `AttributeCode` is already in use by another attribute.
- `AttributeTypeId` does not reference a valid attribute type.

post.description:
Saves locale-specific name and description translations for an existing PIM attribute. The request body must include an `AttributeCode` to identify the target attribute and a `Locales` array containing one entry per language with the translated `AttributeName` and `Description` values. Use this endpoint to add or update the attribute display text for a specific language without changing the attribute's core configuration.

**Note:** This API is a mandatory follow-up step after successfully creating a PIM attribute using the [Create Attribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Create/post) API. It saves the localized attribute information required by the system. If this API is not executed, the attribute may not appear correctly in the Admin panel, and subsequent attribute update APIs may not function as expected.

**Key field validations:**
- `Locales[].LocaleId`: Required. Identifies the language for this translation.

**Workflow:**

1. Use the **[CreatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Create/post)** API to create a new PIM attribute.
2. After successfully creating the attribute, use the **[SaveLocale](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-SaveLocales/post)** API to add or update the localized attribute name and description.
3. To update the core configuration of an existing PIM attribute, use the **[UpdatePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Update/put)** API.
4. To retrieve a list of PIM attributes, use the **[PimAttributeList](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-List/get)** API.
5. To retrieve the details of a specific PIM attribute, use the **[GetPimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Get-id/get)** API.
6. To delete a PIM attribute, use the **[DeletePimAttribute](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/PIMAttribute-Delete/post)** API.

---

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of attribute groups that are not yet assigned to a specific PIM attribute family. Supports filtering and sorting to identify available groups for assignment.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| IsCategory | is (Is) |
| IsNonEditable | is (Is) |
| IsSystemDefined | is (Is) |
| PimAttributeGroupId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodePimAttributeGroupLocales | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| PIMAttributeFamilyId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~eq~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).


---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| IsCategory | Sort by IsCategory. |
| IsNonEditable | Sort by IsNonEditable. |
| IsSystemDefined | Sort by IsSystemDefined. |
| PimAttributeGroupId | Sort by the PimAttributeGroup identifier. |
| ZnodePimAttributeGroupLocales | Sort by ZnodePimAttributeGroupLocales. |
| PIMAttributeFamilyId | Sort by the PIMAttributeFamily identifier. |
| LocaleId | Sort by the Locale identifier. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |

**Example:**
- `sort=IsCategory~asc`


---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| pimattributegroup | Includes the associated attribute group details. |
| attributefamily | Includes the parent attribute family details. |
| pimgrouplocale | Includes locale translations for the attribute group. |
| groupmappers | Includes group-to-family mapping details. |

**Example:**

post.description:
Updates attribute values of one product, identified by its SKU, without re-submitting the full product record. Every value is validated with the same rules as the Admin product page before anything is saved.

---

### Validation

- **All or nothing:** if any value fails validation, nothing is saved and the response lists every problem.
- **Spaces:** spaces before and after a value are removed before the value is validated and saved.
- **Required attributes:** cannot be sent with an empty value.
- **SKU and product type:** cannot be changed. Send the current value of the product or leave the attribute out.
- **Text:** must not exceed the maximum characters and must match the pattern of the attribute, when these are set.
- **Text area:** must not exceed the maximum characters of the attribute, when set.
- **Number:** must match the negative and decimal settings of the attribute and stay within its minimum and maximum, when set.
- **Date:** must be a valid date within the minimum and maximum of the attribute, when set. Dates are saved in the store date format, for example `15-Oct-2026`.
- **Yes/No:** must be `true` or `false`.
- **Simple select and multi select:** must be option codes of the attribute. A multi select value can be sent as one comma-separated value or as one entry per option.
- **Unsafe content:** when XSS validation is enabled in the global settings, HTML tags and script content are rejected, except in attributes that use the rich-text editor.

---

### Clearing a Value

Sending an optional attribute with an empty value removes its value for the requested locale. Values in other locales are kept.

---

### Attribute Codes That Do Not Exist

An attribute code that does not exist is not saved and is returned in `AttributeCodeValueList` with `Status` set to `false`. The other values in the request are still saved.

---

post.description:
Assigns one or more personalized attributes to a product. Personalized attributes allow customers to customize product options during the order process. Duplicate assignments are skipped. Returns a true or false success result.

---

### Note:

The following parameters are required in the request body:

**Required Parameters**

* `PimProductId`
* `PimAttributeId`

**Required LocaleId Filter**

This API supports LocaleId through the Filter object in the request body. LocaleId must be provided as a required filter value.

### Filter Configuration

| Field | Value | Required |
| ----- | ----- | -------- |
| `FilterName` | `LocaleId` | Yes |
| `FilterOperator` | `eq` (Equals) | Yes |
| `FilterValue` | `1` | Yes |

### Example Request Body

```json
{
  "AttributeValues": [
    {
      "PimProductId": 15881,
      "PimAttributeId": 1272
    }
  ],
  "Filter": [
    {
      "FilterName": "LocaleId",
      "FilterOperator": "eq",
      "FilterValue": "1"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

| Field | Supported Operators |

| ZnodeCategoryId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodeProductId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| SKU | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| CatalogId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| CategoryIds | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| RevisionType | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ZnodeCategoryIds | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| fromOrder | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ew (EndsWith), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), is (Is), or (OR), not in (NotIn), ncn (NotContains), bw (Between), nlk (NotLike) |
| UserId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| AttributeValuesForPromotion | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~eq~1`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

| VersionId | Sort by version identifier. |
| ZnodeCatalogId | Sort by znodecatalog identifier. |
| ZnodeCategoryId | Sort by znodecategory identifier. |
| ZnodeProductId | Sort by znodeproduct identifier. |
| SKU | Sort by sku. |
| CatalogId | Sort by catalog identifier. |
| CategoryIds | Sort by category identifiers. |
| PortalId | Sort by portal identifier. |
| RevisionType | Sort by revisiontype. |
| ZnodeCategoryIds | Sort by znodecategory identifiers. |
| fromOrder | Sort by fromorder. |
| UserId | Sort by user identifier. |
| AttributeValuesForPromotion | Sort by attributevaluesforpromotion. |

**Example:**
- `sort=IsActive~asc`

---

### Expand Support

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| VersionId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodeCatalogId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodeCategoryId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ZnodeProductId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~eq~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| LocaleId | Sort by the locale identifier. |
| VersionId | Sort by the version identifier. |
| ZnodeCatalogId | Sort by the catalog identifier. |
| ZnodeCategoryId | Sort by the category identifier. |
| ZnodeProductId | Sort by the product identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=IsActive~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|

| additional-attributes | Includes additional custom attributes for the product. |
| attributelocale | Includes locale-specific attribute values. |
| inventory | Includes inventory and stock level information. |
| pricing | Includes price and pricing tier information. |
| productreviews | Includes customer reviews for the product. |
| producttemplate | Includes product template configuration. |
| promotions | Includes active promotions and discounts applied to the product. |
| selected-additional-attributes | Includes selected additional attributes. |
| category | Includes the category hierarchy for the product. |
| catalog | Includes catalog association details. |

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all available publish state mappings, including their enabled status, display names, and associated catalog and portal configurations. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of publish state records.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| PublishStateId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| StateName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| CreatedBy | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ModifiedBy | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| PublishStateCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| DisplayName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsDefaultContentState | is (Is) |
| IsEnabled | is (Is) |
| IsContentState | is (Is) |
| Description | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| CatalogId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| LocaleId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PortalId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| PublishCatalogId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| RevisionType | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |

**Example:**
- `filter=PublishStateId~eq~Active`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| PublishStateId | Sort by the publish state identifier. |
| StateName | Sort by the state name. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| CreatedBy | Sort by the creator. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedBy | Sort by who last modified the record. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| PublishStateCode | Sort by the publish state code. |
| DisplayName | Sort by the display name. |
| IsDefaultContentState | Sort by the default content state flag. |
| IsEnabled | Sort by the enabled status. |
| IsContentState | Sort by the content state flag. |
| Description | Sort by the description. |
| CatalogId | Sort by the catalog identifier. |
| LocaleId | Sort by the locale identifier. |
| PortalId | Sort by the portal identifier. |
| PublishCatalogId | Sort by the publish catalog identifier. |
| RevisionType | Sort by the revision type. |

**Example:**
- `sort=PublishStateId~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| category | Includes category association details for the publish state. |
| product | Includes product association details for the publish state. |

**Example:**
- `["category", "product"]`

| IsFacet | is (Is) |
| ProductIndex | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| SKU | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| ZnodeCategoryId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

| ZnodeCatalogId | Sort by znodecatalogid. |

If **SEOCode** or these required creation conditions are not met, **CMSSEODetailId** is not generated and SEO creation is skipped, even if the API returns success.

put.description:
This endpoint updates the SEO details for an existing SEO record. It performs a full update rather than a partial update, meaning the entire existing record is replaced with the data sent in the request body.
 
Any field that is left out of the request will be overwritten as null or empty, even if it currently holds a value this endpoint does not merge new data with existing data. For this reason, it is recommended to first retrieve the current SEO details using the corresponding GET endpoint, modify only the fields that need to change, and then send the complete object back, including fields that are not being updated.
 
Three fields are mandatory for this request to succeed:
 
**CMSSEODetailId**: which identifies the specific SEO record being updated.
 
**CMSSEOTypeId** : which identifies the type of SEO record.
 
**SEOCode**: Links the SEO record to its associated entity, such as a product, category, or CMS page.

If any of these required fields are missing, the request will fail validation. Additionally, because this endpoint performs a full update, omitting SEOCode from the request will cause its value in the existing record to be overwritten with null. As a result, the SEO record will no longer be associated with its corresponding entity, causing the relationship to be lost and preventing the entity from remaining in sync with the updated SEO record.

---

- **`GET`** [Retrieve SEO Details by SEO Code](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/SEO-GetSEODetailsBySEOCode-seoCode---seoTypeId---localeId---portalId/get)

**IDOR Validation**

This API supports IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) validation, which is enforced when the **EnableIdorValidation** setting is enabled.

IDOR validation ensures that authenticated users can only access data they are authorized to access.

When enabled, IDOR validation is performed using the **Z-Request-Context** request header.

**Request Headers:**

Z-Request-Context

- A header used to propagate authenticated user context for authorization validation.
**Note**: If the **Z-Request-Context** header is not provided, the API continues to operate with its existing (backward-compatible) behavior, and IDOR validation is not applied.

**Error Handling**
- If IDOR validation fails due to ownership mismatch, invalid user context, or an invalid request context, the API returns a **403 Forbidden response**.
- If other pre-existing validations or business rules apply, the API may return appropriate 4xx error responses or respond with data based on those rules.

**Guest Behavior**
- For guest user flows, where no user identity is associated with the cart, IDOR validation does not apply.

- In such cases, the API follows the existing guest access behavior.
- This approach aligns with the guest checkout design and does not modify current authorization rules.

get.description:
Retrieves the V2 shopping cart details for the specified user and portal using the cart parameter model provided in the request body. The response includes the complete cart with items, calculated totals, available shipping options, and applied discounts. ### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| Id | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| Name | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ncn (NotContains) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=Id~eq~1`

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|

- `sort=Id~asc`

**Filter Format:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|

| LocaleId | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan) |
| OldUrl | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan) |
| PortalId | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ne (NotEquals), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~cn~Active`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| MenuId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |
| RoleMenuId | eq (Equals), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), bw (Between) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~eq~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| IsActive | Sort by whether the page or section is currently active. |
| MenuId | Sort by the menu identifier. |
| RoleMenuId | Sort by the role menu identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=IsActive~asc`

IsCalculateTaxAfterDiscount.description:

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [General Setting / Get Configuration Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/GetConfigurationSettings)

2. The Calculate Tax On The Discounted Price value is displayed in the Configuration Settings form.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [General Setting / Get Configuration Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/GetConfigurationSettings)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [General Setting / Get Configuration Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/GetConfigurationSettings) in the Admin panel.
2. The Promotions With Exceptions value is displayed in the Configuration Settings form.

AllowShippingDiscountsOnHandlingCharges.description:

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [General Setting / Get Configuration Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/GeneralSetting/GetConfigurationSettings)

**How to Retrieve:**

2. The Allow Shipping Discounts On Handling Charges value is displayed in the Configuration Settings form.

FamilyList.description: The list of available product attribute families for the import.

ImportTypeId.description: The unique identifier for the import type. This value determines the category of data being imported, such as products, categories, orders, or customer accounts.

LocaleId.description:

TemplateId.description: The unique identifier for the import template. This references the saved template configuration to use during the import process.

TemplateName.description:
The name of the import template. This field is required.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Import / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Import/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [Import / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Import/List) in the Admin panel.
2. Locate the desired template in the grid.
3. Note the Template Name value shown in the list.

**Knowledgebase:** [Deleting Custom Template](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757089-deleting-custom-template)

TemplateVersion.description: The version identifier of the import template. Use this to track or manage multiple versions of the same template.

Mappings.description: The list of column field mappings that define how source file columns map to target system fields.

FamilyId.description: The unique identifier for the product attribute family. This determines which attribute family structure applies to the imported products.

IsPartialPage.description: Indicates whether to perform a partial page import operation. Set to true to process only a portion of the data, or false to process the full dataset.

PriceListId.description:
The unique identifier for the price list to associate with this import.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Price / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Price/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [Price / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Price/List) in the Admin panel.
2. Click Edit on the desired price list.
3. Check the browser URL and note the PriceListId value in the query string.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Price Lists](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756910-managing-price-lists)

CountryCode.description:
The unique code identifier for the country associated with this import (for example, US or CA).

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Country / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Country/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [Country / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Country/List) in the Admin panel.
2. Locate the desired country in the list.
3. Note the Country Code value shown in the Country Code column.

**Knowledgebase:** [Enabling And Configuring Countries](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757135-enabling-and-configuring-countries)

PortalId.description:
The unique identifier of the store portal associated with this operation.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**

1. Navigate to [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Click on **Manage Store**.
3. Go to the **URL** section.
4. Check the browser URL.
5. Locate the **PortalId** value in the query string parameter.

**Knowledgebase:** [Store Set Up Guide](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757222-store-set-up-guide)

IsAccountAddress.description: Indicates whether the import data pertains to account addresses. Set to true if importing account address records, or false otherwise.

IsAutoPublish.description: Indicates whether the imported data should be automatically published after the import is complete. Set to true to enable automatic publishing, or false to require manual publishing.

CatalogId.description:
The unique identifier for the catalog associated with this import. This field is required.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/CatalogList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [PIM / Catalog List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/CatalogList) in the Admin panel.
2. Locate the desired catalog in the list.
3. Click Edit on the catalog and note the CatalogId value in the browser URL.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Catalogs](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000761617-managing-catalogs)

PromotionTypeId.description: The unique identifier for the promotion type associated with this import.

ImportData.description: The raw import data in base64-encoded format. This field contains the file content to be processed during import.

TouchPointName.description: The name of the touch point used for this import operation. This identifies the integration channel or data source.

IsCompressed.description: Indicates whether the import data is in a compressed format such as ZIP. Set to true if the import file has been compressed, or false for uncompressed files.

MappingId.description: The unique identifier for the field mapping entry.

MapCsvColumn.description: The name of the column in the source CSV file that is being mapped to a target field.

MapTargetColumn.description: The name of the target field in the Znode system that the source CSV column is mapped to.

The product SKU code to look up pricing for.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Products / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [PIM / Products / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List).
2. Check the SKU column in the product listing page.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756872-managing-products)

RetailPrice.description:
The standard retail price for the SKU.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Price / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Price/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. In Znode Admin, navigate to 'OMS' → 'Price Lists'.
2. Click Edit for the desired price list.
3. Click the 'Associated Products' tab.
4. The Retail Price value is displayed in the Retail Price column.

**Knowledgebase:** [Configuring a Price List](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756903-configuring-a-price-list)

SalesPrice.description:
The sales (selling) price for the SKU.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Price / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Price/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. In Znode Admin, click 'OMS' in the main menu.
2. Open 'Price Lists'.
3. Click the Edit button next to the desired price list.
4. Click the 'SKU PRICING' tab.
5. The Sales Price column is shown in the SKU pricing grid.

**Knowledgebase:** [Configuring a Price List](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756903-configuring-a-price-list)

SKUExpirationDate.description: The date and time when the SKU price expires.

TierStartQuantity.description: The minimum quantity at which this tier price applies.

5. Expand the tier pricing section for the SKU; the Tier Price column is shown in the grid.

SKU.description:
The stock-keeping unit code that uniquely identifies the product in inventory. This field is required.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Products / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to PIM, then select Products.
2. Locate the desired product in the product list.
3. Note the SKU value shown in the SKU column of the product listing page.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756872-managing-products)

Quantity.description:
The number of units available in inventory for this SKU. This field is required. Must be a positive number.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [OMS / Inventory](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Inventory/InventorySKUList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to OMS, then select Inventory.
2. Click Edit on the desired SKU inventory record.
3. Select the Manage Inventory section from the left menu.
4. Note the Quantity value displayed in the inventory form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Inventory](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756998-managing-inventory)

BackOrderQuantity.description:
The number of units that can be ordered beyond the current available inventory when back-order is enabled for this SKU.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [OMS / Inventory](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Inventory/InventorySKUList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to OMS, then select Inventory.
2. Click Edit on the desired SKU inventory record.
3. Select the Manage Inventory section from the left menu.
4. Note the Back Order Quantity value displayed in the inventory form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Inventory](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756998-managing-inventory)

BackOrderExpectedDate.description:
The expected date when back-ordered inventory will become available. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [OMS / Inventory](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Inventory/InventorySKUList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to OMS, then select Inventory.
2. Click Edit on the desired SKU inventory record.
3. Select the Manage Inventory section from the left menu.
4. Note the Back Order Expected Date value shown in the inventory form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Inventory](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756998-managing-inventory)

ReOrderLevel.description:
The minimum quantity on hand at which a low-stock alert is triggered for this SKU. When inventory quantity falls at or below this level, a reorder notification is generated.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [OMS / Inventory](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Inventory/InventorySKUList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to OMS, then select Inventory.
2. Click Edit on the desired SKU inventory record.
3. Select the Manage Inventory section from the left menu.
4. Note the Re Order Level value displayed in the inventory form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Inventory](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756998-managing-inventory)

InventoryId.description:

PortalId.description:
The unique identifier of the store portal associated with this operation.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**

1. Navigate to [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Click on **Manage Store**.
3. Go to the **URL** section.
4. Check the browser URL.
5. Locate the **PortalId** value in the query string parameter.

**Knowledgebase:** [Store Set Up Guide](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757222-store-set-up-guide)

SenderEmail.description: The email address from which the email will be sent. If not provided, the store's default sender email address is used.

CustomerServiceEmail.description:
The customer service email address for the store. If provided, it may be included in the email headers or used as a reply-to address.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Stores / Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to Stores, then select Manage Stores.
2. Click Edit on the desired store.
3. Locate the Customer Service Email field in the store settings.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

IsEnableBcc.description: Indicates whether BCC (blind carbon copy) is enabled for this email. Set to true to send a BCC copy, or false to disable BCC.

Subject.description:
The subject line of the email.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [CMS / Email Templates](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/EmailTemplate/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to CMS, then select Email Templates.
2. Click Edit on the desired email template.
3. Note the Subject field value shown in the template edit form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Email Templates](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757046-managing-email-templates)

MessageText.description: The body content of the email message. Can be plain text or HTML, depending on the value of the `IsBodyHtml` field.
MessageText.example: Thank you for your order. Your items are being processed.

IsBodyHtml.description: Indicates whether the message body is formatted as HTML. Set to true if the `MessageText` contains HTML markup, or false for plain text.

AllowGlobalLevelUserCreation.description:
Indicates whether a user who already exists in another store portal can be linked to additional portals. Set to true to allow a single login credential to be shared across multiple store portals, or false to require separate user accounts for each store.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin) in the Admin panel.
2. The Enable Centralized User Login value is displayed in the Centralized Login settings form.

StoresExcludedFromCentralLogin.description:
A comma-separated list of store codes that should be excluded from centralized login. Users for these stores will log in separately.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin) in the Admin panel.
2. The Stores With Exemption value is displayed in the Centralized Login settings form.

EnableUserLevelRestrictions.description:
Indicates whether user-level access restrictions are enforced across portals. When set to true, users registered in multiple portals share the same username, ensuring that login permissions and access controls are applied consistently across all assigned store portals.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to [User / Centralized Login](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/User/CentralizedLogin) in the Admin panel.
2. The Enable User-Level Restrictions for Centralized Login (Stores) value is displayed in the Centralized Login settings form.

AllowGlobalUserCreation.description: If the user already exists for a different portal, then association can be created. With this setting enabled, a single login credential can be used across multiple portals.

StoresExcludedFromCentralLoginIds.description: A list of store codes that are excluded from centralized login. Users for these stores log in separately.

EnableUserLevelRestrictions.description: When enabled, this option groups multiple portals under the same user name, ensuring login access and restrictions are applied consistently across all assigned portals.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**

1. Navigate to [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Click on **Manage Store**.
3. Go to the **URL** section.
4. Check the browser URL.
5. Locate the **PortalId** value in the query string parameter.

**Knowledgebase:** [Store Set Up Guide](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757222-store-set-up-guide)

SmtpId.description:
The unique identifier of the SMTP configuration.

**Reference:** [Get SMTP Details For Specified Portal Id](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/SMTP-GetSMTP-portalId/get)

PortalId.description:
The unique identifier of the store portal associated with this SMTP configuration.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Click on **Manage Store**.
3. Check the browser URL.
4. Locate the **PortalId** value in the query string parameter.

**Knowledgebase:** [Store Set Up Guide](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757222-store-set-up-guide)

SmtpPort.description:
The port number used by the SMTP server.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Manage the desired store.
3. Click the **SMTP** tab, locate the **SMTP Port** field.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

SmtpServer.description:
The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Manage the desired store.
3. Click the **SMTP** tab, locate the **SMTP Server** field.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

SmtpUsername.description:
The username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.

**Reference:** [Get SMTP Details For Specified Portal Id](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/SMTP-GetSMTP-portalId/get)

SmtpPassword.description:
The password used to authenticate with the SMTP server.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Manage the desired store.
3. Click the **SMTP** tab, locate the **SMTP Server Password** field. The value in this field is the SMTP Password.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

FromDisplayName.description:
The display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Manage the desired store.
3. Click the **SMTP** tab, locate the **From Display Name** field.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

FromEmailAddress.description:
The email address used as the sender for outgoing emails.

**Reference:** [Get SMTP Details For Specified Portal Id](https://apidocs-v1.znode.com/#/paths/SMTP-GetSMTP-portalId/get)

BccEmailAddress.description: The email address to which a blind carbon copy (BCC) is sent for all outgoing emails.

PortalName.description:
The name of the store portal associated with this SMTP configuration.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. The **Store Name** column contains the value.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

EnableSslForSmtp.description:
Indicates whether SSL is enabled for the SMTP connection. Set to `true` to enable SSL, or `false` to disable.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Edit the desired store and click on the **SMTP** section.
3. The **Enable SSL** checkbox will be displayed.

**Knowledgebase:** [Configuring SMTP For Store Transactional Emails](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756979-configuring-smtp-for-store-transactional-emails)

DisableAllEmailsForSmtp.description:
Indicates whether all outgoing emails are disabled for this store. Set to `true` to turn off all emails, or `false` to keep them active.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Store / List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List).
2. Manage the desired store.
3. Click the **Advanced SMTP** tab, locate the **Turn off emails** checkbox.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)
